process_area.title: CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

value_stream.name: Corporate Social Responsibility, Foundation & Community Investment

workflows.name: CSR Impact Measurement, Logic Model & Outcome Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - Logic-model/indicator tracker; beneficiary-outcome capture app; outcome-vs-target dashboards
Controls: - CTL-688: programs have logic model & outcome indicators pre-launch; data quality managed; outcomes (not vanity metrics) reported
Cross-references: - links to W4512 (data), VS-28 (analytics), VS-44 (insights), VS-36 (board), W4514–W4517 (programs), W4522 (SROI), W4525 (feedback)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Vanity-metric risk**: Tracking outputs (houses built) not outcomes (lives improved); mitigated by outcome-focused logic model
- **Attribution risk**: Claiming impact not caused by the program; mitigated by counterfactual/baseline design
System Touchpoints: - CSR data/impact model (W4512); analytics (VS-28); insights/feedback (VS-44); board governance (VS-36)

steps.activity: M&E/Foundation ED build the logic model / theory of change per program (inputs → activities → outputs → outcomes → impact) and define indicators (IRIS+/SMART) before launch
M&E/Partners collect output/outcome data (beneficiaries reached, houses built, income gained, enterprises surviving) on the CSR data platform (W4512), with data quality
M&E/Foundation ED analyze outcomes vs targets, capture beneficiary feedback (VS-44/W4525), and report to the board (VS-36) and into SROI (W4522)

fields.Volume: SROI/benefit valuation across the CSR portfolio

workflows.name: Social Return on Investment (SROI) & Benefit Valuation

Automation Opportunity: - SROI calculation tooling; outcome-to-value proxy library; portfolio SROI dashboard
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: SROI conservatively valued w/ methodology disclosed; multi-criteria allocation; board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-33 (strategy), VS-28 (analytics), VS-36 (board), W4521 (outcomes), W4508 (budget)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-valuation risk**: Inflated SROI → greenwashing/credibility loss; mitigated by conservative proxies & methodology disclosure
- **Decision-misuse risk**: SROI as sole allocator → misses non-monetizable value; mitigated by multi-criteria allocation
System Touchpoints: - Finance/FP&A (VS-17.4); strategy (VS-33); analytics (VS-28); board (VS-36); CSR data (W4512)

steps.activity: Finance/M&E/Foundation ED value social outcomes monetarily (SROI methodology — housing value, income gain, avoided disaster cost) using outcome data (W4521) and standard proxies
Foundation ED/Strategy compare SROI across programs/geographies, informing portfolio allocation (W4508) and investment decisions
Finance/Foundation ED report SROI to the board (VS-36) and integrate into CSR reporting (W4523), with methodology transparency (avoid over-claiming)

fields.Owner: Sustainability/ESG Manager / Foundation ED / ESG (VS-25) / Reporting (VS-17.4)
fields.Volume: CSR/ESG disclosure (GRI social indicators, IRIS+, integrated report)

Automation Opportunity: - Disclosure-metric automation from CSR data; GRI/IRIS+ mapping; data-lineage/assurance support
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: social disclosure accurate & assured (VS-21); data-traceable (W4512); greenwashing-controlled (W4527)
Cross-references: - links to VS-25 (ESG), VS-103 (HR), VS-17.4 (reporting), VS-21 (audit), VS-22 (compliance), W4512 (data), W4527 (greenwashing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: Overstated social disclosure → reputational/regulatory risk; mitigated by conservative claims & assurance
- **Data-traceability risk**: Unsubstantiated metrics; mitigated by data lineage (W4512) & audit (VS-21)
System Touchpoints: - ESG (VS-25); HR/people (VS-103); finance/reporting (VS-17.4); audit (VS-21); compliance (VS-22); CSR data (W4512)

steps.activity: Sustainability/ESG Manager/Foundation ED prepare the CSR/social disclosures (GRI 400-series social, IRIS+ metrics, community-investment spend, Foundation activity) integrating with ESG reporting (VS-25)
Reporting/Audit ensure disclosure accuracy/assurance (internal VS-21 + optional external assurance), data traceability (W4512), and alignment to integrated reporting (VS-17)
Sustainability/ESG Manager/Compliance manage disclosure to stakeholders (B2B customer ESG due diligence, investors, regulators), with greenwashing-risk control (W4527)

fields.Volume: Foundation annual report + external audit + regulatory filings

workflows.name: Foundation Annual Report, Audit & Regulatory Filing

Automation Opportunity: - Annual-report/filing automation; audit-evidence pack; regulatory-calendar integration
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: Foundation books separately audited (VS-21); SEC/BIR/PCNC filings on time (W4506/W4507); board-approved & records-lodged (VS-88)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (finance), VS-21 (audit), VS-79 (tax), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-36 (governance), VS-88 (records), W4506/W4507 (accreditation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Filing-lapse risk**: Missed SEC/BIR/PCNC filing → penalty/accreditation loss; mitigated by regulatory calendar (W4506)
- **Audit-finding risk**: Foundation audit findings; mitigated by fund-use discipline (W4508) & separate books
System Touchpoints: - Finance/GL (VS-17); audit (VS-21); tax (VS-79); legal (VS-100.3); governance (VS-36); records (VS-88)

steps.activity: Finance/Foundation ED prepare the Foundation annual report (activity, impact W4521, financials) and external-audit-ready books, separate from operating entities (VS-17)
Audit/Tax complete the external audit and regulatory filings (SEC annual, BIR donee re-accreditation evidence W4506, PCNC renewal W4507) per calendar
Corp Secretary/Board approve and file the report, publish to stakeholders (W4525/W4526), and lodge in records (VS-88)

fields.Participants: Store network (VS-07), Insights (VS-44), Partners (W4519), Govt Affairs (VS-104)

Automation Opportunity: - Beneficiary-feedback/grievance platform; community-engagement tracker; closed-loop communication
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: programs co-created w/ community; grievance mechanism (VS-119); feedback closed-loop
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (stores), VS-44 (insights), W4519 (partners), VS-76/VS-104 (LGU/govt), VS-119 (speak-up), W4512 (data)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Top-down risk**: Programs imposed without community input → low uptake; mitigated by co-creation engagement
- **Grievance-gap risk**: Beneficiaries can't raise concerns; mitigated by grievance mechanism (VS-119)
System Touchpoints: - Store network (VS-07); insights/feedback (VS-44); partners (W4519); LGU (VS-76/VS-104); speak-up (VS-119); CSR data (W4512)

steps.activity: Programs/Foundation ED engage communities/beneficiaries in program design (co-creation, not top-down), leveraging the store network (VS-07) and partners (W4519)
Programs/Insights collect beneficiary feedback (satisfaction, unintended effects, grievances) via VS-44, with a grievance mechanism linked to speak-up (VS-119)
Programs/Foundation ED close the loop (communicate outcomes, adapt programs), manage community relationships/LGU (VS-76/VS-104), and sustain trust

fields.Volume: CSR comms to ~600K loyalty members, 6,762 employees, public

Automation Opportunity: - POS round-up automation; loyalty cause-rewards (VS-13); impact-storytelling content pipeline
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: CSR comms authentic-impact-only (W4527); customer data consent-respecting (VS-91); round-up receipted (W4506)
Cross-references: - links to VS-14.3/VS-14.2 (brand/digital), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-08 (POS), VS-103.2 (EX), VS-91 (privacy), W4518 (volunteerism), W4527 (greenwashing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cause-marketing-overreach risk**: CSR comms overstate impact → greenwashing (W4527); mitigated by authentic-impact-only rule
- **Privacy risk**: Customer donation data; mitigated by consent (VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Brand/PR (VS-14.3); digital (VS-14.2); CRM/loyalty (VS-13); POS (VS-08); EX/HRSS (VS-103.2); privacy (VS-91)

steps.activity: Marketing/Foundation ED plan CSR communication (cause-marketing, round-up-at-POS, customer donation, Foundation storytelling), aligned to authentic impact (W4527)
Digital/CRM execute customer CSR engagement (loyalty cause-rewards VS-13, social/digital VS-14.2, POS round-up VS-08), with consent/privacy (VS-91)
EX/Foundation ED communicate CSR to employees (pride, volunteering W4518, payroll-giving), integrating into engagement (VS-103.2)

fields.Owner: Foundation ED / Sustainability/ESG Manager / Compliance (VS-22) / Brand (VS-14.3)

Automation Opportunity: - Claim-vs-evidence checker; CSR-claim register; reputation-risk monitoring
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: CSR claims evidence-backed (W4521); reviewed pre-publication; greenwashing-risk in ERM (VS-21.2); incidents managed (VS-14.3)
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-21 (audit), VS-14.3 (brand/PR), VS-25 (ESG), VS-21.2 (ERM), W4521 (impact), W4523/W4526 (reporting/comms)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: Overstated CSR claims → consumer/regulatory backlash (RA 7394/SEC); mitigated by evidence-backed-claims-only & review gate
- **Reputational risk**: CSR misstep amplified; mitigated by authenticity discipline & crisis-ready (VS-14.3)
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); audit (VS-21); brand/PR (VS-14.3); ESG (VS-25); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Sustainability/ESG Manager/Compliance/Brand define the greenwashing-risk framework (evidence-backed claims, no overstatement, regulatory exposure under consumer protection RA 7394/SEC), per W4523/W4526
Brand/Foundation ED review all CSR claims/comms for substantiation (impact data W4521 vs claim), aligned to VS-14.3 brand integrity

steps.a: VP Legal / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Compliance/Legal manage any greenwashing/reputation incident (links to VS-22/VS-100.3/VS-14.3 crisis), and report to the board risk committee (VS-36)

fields.Volume: CSR portfolio review across all programs

workflows.name: CSR Continuous Improvement, Learning & Portfolio Review

Automation Opportunity: - Portfolio-performance dashboard; learning repository; outcome-based scale/exit recommendations
Controls: - CTL-688 (ensure controlled execution — CSR Impact Measurement, Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement (PA-152.3).)
- CTL-688: portfolio reviewed vs outcomes/SROI (W4521/W4522); low-impact exited; learnings captured; board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-133 (OpEx), VS-36 (board), W4505 (strategy), W4521/W4522 (outcomes/SROI), W4508 (budget)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sunk-cost bias risk**: Continuing low-impact programs; mitigated by outcome/SROI-based exit decisions
- **Learning-loss risk**: Lessons not captured; mitigated by institutional-learning repository
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); finance (VS-17.4); OpEx (VS-133); board (VS-36); CSR data (W4512)

steps.activity: Foundation ED/M&E review the portfolio against strategy (W4505), outcomes (W4521), and SROI (W4522), identifying high/low performers and learning
Programs/Foundation ED apply learnings (scale high-impact, redesign/exit low-impact), align to OpEx continuous-improvement (VS-133), and reallocate budget (W4508)
Foundation ED/Sustainability Lead capture institutional learning (what works in PH community context), report portfolio health/decisions to the board (VS-36), and feed strategy (W4505)
